paragraphs: The “Office Supplies” category is a top-level department in Shopify’s product taxonomy. It brings together the product families assigned to Office Supplies, providing the starting point for classification throughout this branch of the catalog. Its immediate branches include Book Accessories, Desk Pads & Blotters, Filing & Organization, General Office Supplies, Impulse Sealers and additional specialized categories.

When describing products in Office Supplies, useful Shopify classification details include Material: Defines a product's primary material, such as cotton or wool. These are descriptive comparison points rather than required GitStore category fields; retain the product’s actual characteristics when choosing a category. Where an immediate branch describes the product more precisely, follow that branch and continue to the most appropriate specific category.
